internal_measurement.evaluator: material-only release validation; no new evaluator adopted
internal_measurement.results: Workspace release tests, Clippy with warnings denied, rustfmt, the optional opening-book build and tests, a native material-only USI smoke, the 98% hosted coverage gate, hosted browser WebAssembly tests, local WebAssembly package generation, package metadata validation, and CodeQL passed. Opt-in Lazy SMP diagnostics report worker-local TT activity and shared-table write topology without changing the default search path. Bounded CSA runs may reconnect after post-game transport closure while preserving completed-game progress. No general playing-strength claim is made.

external_opponents.configuration: No external engine, evaluator, weights, labels, Suisho5-derived scores, or Suisho5-derived opening positions are used as release evidence for v0.3.72.

known_limitations: No new NNUE checkpoint is bundled or adopted, and this release makes no general playing-strength claim.
Lazy SMP counters are opt-in diagnostics with relaxed atomic overhead and must not be used as the NPS timing baseline.
The post-game CSA reconnect path improves bounded-run continuity but does not prove playing-strength improvement.
The optional v0.3.38 checkpoint and its material-baseline recommendation remain unchanged.
Parallel search can vary by scheduler; deterministic diagnostics require one thread and SpecTopN=0.
The WebAssembly package is distributed as a GitHub Release asset and is not published to the npm registry.
External HalfKP inference remains optional and requires a separately obtained, license-compatible nn.bin file with its own provenance and operating scale.
